fusions.name: Shed Tail
fusions.desc: Costs 5% of your maximum health. A lash that deals 8 damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.2 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Strike From Stillness
fusions.desc: Lunges at a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 30 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. It ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Basking on the Heap
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Haft
fusions.desc: By day, your damage rises by 10%.
